translated_text: Paris, 1st III.40 My dearest, Finally, well after noon, the first letter in 11 days. It's my letter dated the 23rd and sent by censorship of 37. By morning I received my card dated the 26th and a letter from the 25th. Your letters of the 19th, 20th, 21st, 22nd, as well as the one from the 24th, are lost. It's truly terrible; I wonder if there's anything that can be done about it?! I've already asked. My safe-conduct at the police station for next week. I wanted to go to... Now I'm naturally postponing this trip, especially since you're coming to Paris around the 10th... Listen, Bobchen, I would very much like you to bring with you, if possible, the negatives of the first two reports. I would need quite a few prints. Mrs. Darle could do it, and you could take the films home with you. We'll print whatever you want from Avenue La Bourdonnais. You know, Mrs. Darle works very quickly, and you'll have everything you need in a few days. My little one, Mama is asking you for oil (your 2 liters) if you have any there. I'm not sending you any films, I'm sending them home. But do you want some money? At home, everything is fine, only you're starting to miss us terribly. I'm already counting the hours, and I hope that by then I'll have a few more letters. I love you, my love, and I'm waiting for you. Baba Zwei PARIS 69 1140 15 30 DEV ILLE CH AF M 1.140 1530 VOUILLE LOVAQUES dipeuthard M: Robert Zweigenthal ija Reg. 4 MAR 1940 comp S-POSTENAUX AR SP2197 2197 SP 2197 ENSKA VOJ. POSTA WEAPON *A* POSITION
